name: clarify_release_travel_programme
query: Decision date: 2026-11-10. An employee is travelling business class from Australia to Singapore for research, carrying a registered prototype with Asset Team transport authorisation naming this journey. One quotation, line-manager spending approval and trip authorisation cover $4,200. Travel Desk will book. The programme name is not supplied. Can the regional pilot clear the cabin?
ground_truth: Ask which named programme the employee is travelling under. Research purpose alone does not establish Meridian membership. Do not assume standing cabin clearance or enumerate competing approval routes before resolving the programme. Route, prototype, transport authorisation and ordinary approvals are already known. Sources: [policy:regional-travel] [policy:business-travel] [policy:purchasing].

name: remaining_release_equipment_two_limits
query: Decision date: 2026-12-31. I am a New Zealand-contractual-location employee replacing a 35-month-old personal home-office desk for $900, after using $350 of the year's allowance. It is not an accessibility adjustment. One quotation and line-manager approval cover the order. What remains before ordering today?
ground_truth: Obtain People Operations approval for both the $50 allowance excess and early replacement. The pilot is still valid today: $350+$900=$1,250 exceeds New Zealand's $1,200 limit, and desks retain 36 months rather than the chair/monitor pilot ages. Spending approval is complete. Do not reset earlier spending or require Asset Team reuse confirmation. Sources: [policy:regional-equipment] [policy:home-office] [policy:purchasing].

name: exception_release_supplier_last_day
query: Decision date: 2026-11-05. Aster Analytics is ready to start a $3,600 two-week project processing customer contact names in Canada. A quotation, line-manager approval, complete Service Owner-approved statement of work, Procurement Lead standard-contract approval, Privacy Officer purpose/field and Canada approvals, and a data-processing agreement are complete. No software is purchased. Can we commit today?
ground_truth: No: November 5 is the inclusive final day of Aster's hold on customer personal information processed outside Australia. Stop the affected commitment and refer it to Procurement Lead. Ordinary approvals and the agreement do not waive the hold. Do not treat the entry as already expired or request completed privacy approvals again. Sources: [policy:supplier-restrictions] [policy:external-consultants] [policy:data-handling] [policy:purchasing].

name: ready_release_records_revised_deadline
query: Decision date: 2026-11-23. A consulting engagement completed October 20. One supplier-held file contained both personal interview notes and confidential pricing. Service Owner confirmed return. A written Records Manager hold named that file through November 18 inclusive. The supplier deleted its copy and supplied the matching certificate today; our master copy is retained. No new fee is involved. Is closeout late?
ground_truth: No: the original 30-day deadline for the mixed-category file was November 19. Five days after the hold ended is November 23, so the later revised deadline is today inclusive. Return and deletion/certificate requirements are complete. Do not apply the 90-day period, require deletion of the organisational master or add new purchasing approval. Source: [policy:records-return].

name: clarify_release_funding_support_split
query: Decision date: 2026-10-28. Three graduate delegates have a $4,500 conference invoice covering tickets, compulsory workshops and accessibility support approved by the Accessibility Team. The support amount is not separately itemised. One quotation, line-manager spending approval, Events Lead and Training Lead approvals are complete. There is no travel or sponsorship. Can we decide if learning-budget excess approval is needed?
ground_truth: Ask for an itemised amount separating the approved accessibility support from tickets and compulsory workshops. Only the separately itemised approved support can be excluded from the learning-cost numerator. Do not divide all $4,500 by three or assume a funding excess before resolving that allocation. Other approvals and delegate group/count are known. Sources: [policy:event-funding] [policy:accessibility] [policy:events] [policy:training-suitability] [policy:purchasing].

name: remaining_release_travel_short_segment
query: Decision date: 2026-11-15. An Orion field-service employee will fly nonstop business class from Australia to Japan on a scheduled eight-hour fifty-nine-minute segment. Two quotations, Category Manager spending approval and line-manager trip authorisation cover the $5,800 trip. Travel Desk will book. Does the pilot remove the need for individual cabin approval?
ground_truth: No: obtain Travel Director business-class cabin approval before booking. Eight hours fifty-nine minutes is below the pilot's nine-hour minimum; do not round it up. Programme, route and decision date match, and purchasing/trip prerequisites are complete. Sources: [policy:regional-travel] [policy:business-travel] [policy:purchasing].

name: exception_release_equipment_before_pilot
query: Decision date: 2026-10-14. A New Zealand-based employee wants to replace a 24-month-old personal home-office chair for $1,100. No allowance has been used this year. A quotation and line-manager spending approval are complete, and this is not an accessibility adjustment. Can tomorrow's regional pilot cover an order placed today?
ground_truth: No. Today precedes the October 15 pilot start, so ordinary $800 allowance and 36-month age rules apply. Obtain People Operations excess-allowance and early-replacement approvals before today's commitment, or defer the decision and reassess on its actual date. Do not apply tomorrow's limits retroactively or repeat completed purchasing approvals. Sources: [policy:regional-equipment] [policy:home-office] [policy:purchasing].

name: ready_release_software_manual
query: Decision date: 2026-10-21. Our $2,900 DesignCloud Studio purchase is only for manually creating graphics from public templates and already-public marketing assets, with business-email login. It will not use automated bulk publishing. A quotation and line-manager spending approval are obtained. Does the October pause stop this purchase?
ground_truth: No outstanding requirement is identified. The scoped pause covers automated bulk publishing, not this manual creation workflow. The public-assets security clearance covers the stated data and date. Do not require a Procurement Lead waiver, new security review or repeat purchasing approvals. Sources: [policy:supplier-restrictions] [policy:software-review] [notice:designcloud-public-clearance] [policy:purchasing].

name: clarify_release_equipment_employment
query: Decision date: 2026-10-25. A worker contractually located in New Zealand requests an initial $650 personal home-office monitor. No allowance has been used and there is no accessibility adjustment. We have a quotation and a manager's spending approval, but the worker may be an employee or an independent contractor. Can we use the employee allowance?
ground_truth: Establish employee versus independent-contractor status. Contractual location alone does not establish eligibility for the employee allowance; do not assume eligibility or enumerate alternative purchase routes before resolving status. Item, amount, location and initial-purchase facts are known. Sources: [policy:regional-equipment] [policy:home-office] [policy:purchasing].

name: remaining_release_changed_contract_terms
query: Decision date: 2026-10-25. Before signing a $4,300 consulting engagement, we switched from our unmodified organisation contract to supplier-written terms. Deliverables, fee, duration and public-only data are unchanged. One quotation and line-manager spending approval cover the full engagement; Service Owner and Procurement Lead explicitly approved the revised agreement. What further review is required?
ground_truth: Obtain Legal Team approval of the supplier-written terms before commitment. The switch creates a terms-review requirement even though work and value are unchanged. Do not repeat Procurement Lead, Service Owner or spending approval or invent privacy/software review for public-only consultancy. Sources: [policy:contract-changes] [policy:external-consultants] [policy:data-handling] [policy:purchasing].

name: exception_release_accessibility_region
query: Decision date: 2026-12-01. A Singapore employee has Accessibility Team approval for an initial $5,000 home-office desk adjustment. Their ordinary allowance is exhausted. One quotation and line-manager spending approval cover the desk; no software is included. Do we need a regional excess approval or Category Manager approval?
ground_truth: Neither additional approval is required. The approved accessibility adjustment is outside ordinary/regional allowance limits, and exactly $5,000 remains in the one-quotation plus line-manager purchasing route. Existing requirements are complete; do not add a sole-supplier determination or software review. Sources: [policy:accessibility] [policy:regional-equipment] [policy:home-office] [policy:purchasing].

name: ready_release_supplier_domestic_scope
query: Decision date: 2026-10-22. Aster Analytics will analyse customer names and business emails wholly in Australia for a $4,200 two-week project. One quotation, line-manager approval, a complete Service Owner-approved statement of work, Procurement Lead approval of our unmodified standard contract, Privacy Officer purpose/field approval and an executed data-processing agreement are complete. No software is purchased. Is the supplier hold a blocker?
ground_truth: No matching hold or outstanding requirement is identified. Aster's entry requires customer personal information processed outside Australia; wholly Australian processing is outside it. No overseas-processing approval is required. Do not seek an invented hold waiver or repeat completed purchasing, contract or ordinary privacy requirements. Sources: [policy:supplier-restrictions] [policy:external-consultants] [policy:data-handling] [policy:purchasing].

name: clarify_release_records_hold_end
query: Decision date: 2026-11-20. A consultant finished on October 15 and returned the necessary personal interview records, confirmed by Service Owner. Records Manager issued a written audit hold naming the supplier's interview-note copies, but its end date is missing. No deletion certificate exists and closeout has no new fee. Should we declare a missed deletion deadline?
ground_truth: Seek clarification of the audit hold's end date from Records Manager before determining the applicable revised deletion deadline. Protect the held copies; do not invent a disposal date, instruct deletion during the hold or declare noncompliance solely from the ordinary 30-day date. Return confirmation is complete. Source: [policy:records-return].

name: remaining_release_research_funding
query: Decision date: 2026-11-02. Three research staff will attend learning sessions: conference tickets cost $3,600 and compulsory workshops $900, with $1,800 economy travel separately itemised in the same $6,300 commitment. Two quotations, Category Manager spending approval, Events Lead, Training Lead and line-manager trip approvals are obtained. Travel Desk will book. Is the learning budget satisfied?
ground_truth: Obtain Learning Budget Owner excess-funding approval: ($3,600+$900)/3=$1,500 per research delegate, above the $1,400 limit. Exclude travel from learning cost but not the $6,300 purchasing total, whose prerequisites are complete. Do not add sponsorship or cabin approval or repeat the approvals supplied. Sources: [policy:event-funding] [policy:events] [policy:training-suitability] [policy:business-travel] [policy:purchasing].

name: exception_release_travel_final_day
query: Decision date: 2026-11-30. An Orion field-service employee is booking a nine-hour nonstop business-class flight from Australia to Japan, departing December 8. Trip authorisation, one quotation and line-manager spending approval cover the $4,900 journey. Travel Desk will book today. Is December departure outside the cabin pilot?
ground_truth: No. Eligibility uses the booking-decision date; November 30 is included even for December departure. Orion, route and exactly nine hours qualify for standing business-class clearance, so no individual Travel Director approval is needed. Purchasing and trip requirements are complete; have Travel Desk book today. Sources: [policy:regional-travel] [policy:business-travel] [policy:purchasing].

name: ready_release_marketing_after_hold
query: Decision date: 2026-10-26. We want a $2,600 physical-merchandise reprint from PrintForge. Design, message and format are unchanged from Brand Team approval, and PrintForge is confirmed on the approved supplier list. One quotation and line-manager spending approval are complete. Can we commit today?
ground_truth: Yes, no outstanding requirement is identified. PrintForge's physical-production hold ended October 25 inclusive. The exact reprint can reuse artwork approval, and supplier-list and purchasing requirements are complete. Do not demand new artwork approval or a Procurement Lead release waiver. Sources: [policy:supplier-restrictions] [policy:marketing] [policy:purchasing].

name: clarify_release_nova_documents
query: Decision date: 2026-10-20. We want $6,200 of Nova Learning Portal licences for leadership development. Two quotations, Category Manager spending approval and Training Lead suitability approval are complete. Staff will upload supporting documents as well as names, emails and completion records. Can the existing portal clearance cover this?
ground_truth: Ask what the supporting documents contain and what data will be uploaded. Their scope is needed to determine clearance applicability; do not assume all supporting documents are public or treat them automatically as performance reviews. Do not enumerate alternative security-review routes before resolving content. Programme, cost and completed approvals are already known; the graduate exception is irrelevant. Sources: [policy:software-review] [notice:nova-portal-clearance] [policy:training-suitability] [policy:purchasing].

name: remaining_release_confidential_closeout
query: Decision date: 2027-01-11. A consultancy completed October 12, 2026. Service Owner confirmed return, but the supplier still has confidential pricing files containing no personal information and has supplied no deletion certificate. No audit hold exists and closeout creates no new fee. What should happen now?
ground_truth: Escalate immediately to Records Manager and the relevant Data Owner. The confidential non-personal deadline was January 10, 2027 inclusive, 90 calendar days after completion. Do not apply the shorter personal-data period, claim deletion happened or prescribe new purchasing approvals as the remedy. Source: [policy:records-return].

name: exception_release_cancel_after_deadline
query: Decision date: 2026-11-06. TaskNest automatically renews on December 5, 2026, for $7,000 with a 30-calendar-day cancellation-notice period. Service Owner wants to cancel, but no notice has been sent. Can we simply send a fee-free cancellation now?
ground_truth: The inclusive deadline was November 5, so escalate immediately to Procurement Lead to establish the contractual position. Do not promise fee-free late cancellation, a refund or that the next term is authorised. Sending a routine notice is not proof of a contractual right after the deadline. Source: [policy:subscription-renewals].

name: ready_release_mixed_event_funding
query: Decision date: 2026-11-03. Four graduates have a conference package: $3,600 tickets/workshops, $4,500 economy travel, $2,000 sponsorship and a separately itemised $600 accessibility support service approved by Accessibility Team. Two quotations and Category Manager approval cover the $10,700 total. Events Lead, Training Lead, Marketing Director and line-manager trip approvals are obtained. No new artwork or online service is purchased; Travel Desk will book. Does learning funding add a blocker?
ground_truth: No outstanding requirement is identified. Approved itemised accessibility support, travel and sponsorship are excluded from the learning numerator: $3,600/4=$900 per graduate, exactly permitted. All $10,700 still counts for purchasing, whose requirements and other stated approvals are complete. Do not require Learning Budget Owner excess approval or repeat completed approvals. Use Travel Desk for travel booking. Sources: [policy:event-funding] [policy:events] [policy:training-suitability] [policy:accessibility] [policy:business-travel] [policy:purchasing].

name: clarify_release_changed_data_scope
query: Decision date: 2026-10-29. Before signing an otherwise approved $3,800 public-data consultancy, we proposed adding staff-record analysis. The supplier has not specified which staff-record fields it needs or the processing country. The fee and contract terms are unchanged. What must we establish before saying existing permissions cover the change?
ground_truth: Ask which staff information/fields will be shared, their intended analysis purpose and the processing country. Existing permission for public documents does not establish the revised data scope. Do not assume Australian processing, claim existing permission is sufficient or enumerate conditional privacy routes while the scope is unresolved. Changed work requires appropriate amendment review, but that does not replace resolving these missing facts. Sources: [policy:contract-changes] [policy:data-handling] [policy:external-consultants].

name: remaining_release_hospitality_official
query: Decision date: 2026-10-29. We plan a business review lunch for six people, one a municipal procurement officer. The complete bill is $570 including tax, service and soft drinks only. One quotation and line-manager spending approval are obtained. May we book on that basis?
ground_truth: Obtain Ethics Officer approval before commitment because a public official attends. At $95 each and with no alcohol, Hospitality Lead approval is not required. Spending prerequisites are complete; do not treat the low cost as an ethics exemption. Sources: [policy:hospitality] [policy:purchasing].

name: exception_release_accessibility_spending
query: Decision date: 2026-10-29. An employee has specific Accessibility Team approval for an initial $8,700 home-office workstation and a written sole-supplier determination naming its item and supplier. One quotation and Head of Learning spending approval are obtained. There is no training or software purchase. Can we order with that approval?
ground_truth: Obtain Category Manager spending approval for the $8,700 commitment. The sole-supplier determination makes the one quotation sufficient but does not change the spending approver. Head of Learning approval is not the applicable route for this equipment; the Nova training exception does not apply. Approved accessibility equipment is outside home-office allowance limits. Sources: [policy:accessibility] [policy:home-office] [policy:purchasing] [notice:nova-graduate-exception].

name: ready_release_paid_device_disposal
query: Decision date: 2026-10-29. We are disposing of organisational tablets through an approved recycler for a total $5,600 service fee. Asset Team retirement approval and IT sanitisation certificates for every device are obtained. Two supplier quotations and Category Manager spending approval cover the disposal. No new equipment is being bought and no consultant-held records are involved. Can the tablets be released?
ground_truth: Yes, no outstanding requirement is identified. Retirement, approved recycler and device sanitisation prerequisites are complete, and the paid service above $5,000 has the required quotations and Category Manager approval. Do not require a reuse check when there is no replacement purchase, a destruction plan where sanitisation succeeded or a consultant-closeout certificate. Sources: [policy:sustainable-purchasing] [policy:purchasing].
